reason: Definition and consistency inspected: c-softness is surjectivity of the restriction map from global sections to sections over every compact set, and the neighbourhood formulation is exactly the isomorphism of lem-sections-near-a-compact-set-are-sections-on-that-set; flasque sheaves are c-soft because a class over a compact set is represented on an open neighbourhood, which flasqueness extends.
